sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Irritable, sensitive to external impressions;
hot, full and heavy head ; lachrymation, with coryza
profuse, fluent, v ith constant sneezing ; loss of smell
and taste ; coryza zuiih cough.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Dry, pain during empty swallowing,
tenacious mucus. Mouth dry.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Dry cough from sternal region all
over chest. Hoarseness, larynx painful. Paroxysmal
cough, with suffocative obstruction of respiration. Cough
untJ* sneezing. Severe dyspnoea with cough. Tightness
across chest. Asthmatic attacks, cannot endure a close,
warm room. Whooping-cough.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Seems to come between Cepa and
Euphrasia, which compare.
